services.name: Hunting & Fishing
services.desc: The pioneer spirit comes alive in De Smet, where abundant wildlife and outdoor recreation mix with the rich history of author Laura Ingalls Wilder, who left her mark on this colorful town over 100 years ago. With thousands of acres of public lands and numerous pothole lakes and sloughs, the open prairies around De Smet and Kingsbury County are a favorite spot for hunters and fishermen. Head out on your own or with the help of one of our experienced guide services. Lake Thompson and Dry Lake #2 are a short drive from De Smet and offer great open-water and ice-fishing opportunities.
